steps.title: Given the user is on Manage Scope > Prompts of analysis A with the pool exactly full

steps.title: Given the user is on Manage Scope > Prompts of analysis A with no free slot
steps.detail: Pool = U = 713. Decathlon b6c8b664 ring "713 / 713", stroke rgb(245,158,11) amber.

steps.title: When the user tries to tick a suggested prompt
steps.detail: Row "What do you think of Decathlon?" (first unticked suggestion): checkbox disabled, forced click leaves it unticked; 7/7 suggestion checkboxes disabled.

steps.detail: Add prompt disabled; forced click opens no dialog and no input row; 0 write request. Prompt text "Which brand sells the best climbing ropes?" could not be entered (expected).

steps.detail: Not executed: "Untick 1 kept prompt and save" requires saving on the analysis.

results.title: Over the pool the add actions stay disabled while editing, deleting and unticking stay possible

steps.title: Given the user is on Manage Scope > Prompts of analysis A with the pool 2 slots below usage
steps.detail: Pool set to U - 2 = 711. Decathlon b6c8b664 ring "713 / 711", stroke rgb(220,38,38) red, number oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325) red. Message "2 prompts over. Untick prompts or contact your account manager." (wizard.pool.overWizard_other).

steps.title: When the user looks at the add actions and the suggested prompts
steps.detail: Add prompt, Add Country, Add Category disabled; 7/7 suggestions disabled, forced click leaves them unticked.

steps.title: And the user edits the wording of a kept prompt and saves
steps.detail: Edit control enabled (140/140); clicking Edit on "Decathlon reviews?" opens the inline text box. Cancelled with Escape, not saved.

steps.title: And the user deletes a kept prompt
steps.detail: Delete enabled (140/140); dialog "Delete Prompt" opens with "Its slot returns to the prompt pool. Results from past runs stay in the history; the prompt is no longer asked from the next analysis re-run." (views.manageScope.prompts.deleteModalNextRun). Cancelled.

steps.title: Then unticking a kept prompt stays possible
steps.detail: Kept checkbox enabled; one click sent PATCH /reports/b6c8b664.../prompts/kept {isKept:false} immediately, aborted by the write guard (no confirmation dialog). After reload the prompt is still kept (133 kept / 7 unticked). Ring "U - 2 / U - 2" not verifiable.

results.notes: PARTIAL: Given/When verified; edit/delete/untick verified only as enabled controls up to their editor/dialog/request, never saved.
